text: maria: heads-up, found a 404 in the KB while doing a quick read-through this morning — probably a redirect miss. link: https://kb.redwood.com/runtime/kv-cache#prefix-quick aj: can you drop the file path? i'll take a look later today :+1: docbot: [scan] crawled /runtime/kv-cache — 1 broken link at anchor "#prefix-quick" -> 404 maria: file path looks like `content/docs/runtime/kv-cache.md` — anchor `#prefix-quick` doesn't resolve. not sure who's the owner, no CODEOWNERS mention sarah: cc @aj — editorial usually handles anchors but owners would be the infra docs team. maybe add a short redirect instead of changing anchors? tyler: if it's just an anchor mismatch, prefer to add an anchor in the doc rather than redirecting the old URL. redirects add maintenance. can you show the offending URL and the suggested spot? aj: i'll open a tiny PR. plan: add the missing anchor and a one-line changelog entry. sed i'll run locally: ``` # add anchor after the 'Prefix caching' header python - <<'PY' import io,sys p='content/docs/runtime/kv-cache.md' s=open(p).read() if 'Prefix caching' in s and 'prefix-quick' not in s: s=s.replace('## Prefix caching','## Prefix caching\n') open(p,'w').write(s) print('patched') else: print('no-op') PY ``` maria: that works. if you can also add a short test in `docs/tests/link-checks.md` even better. otherwise i'll patch on monday. aj: will do. opening PR now and tagging @sarah for review. PR will be tiny — sed + test + one-line CHANGELOG.
